monologue: Forty-nine is a warm hand on the shoulder. The card is a little busy, twenty-five percent, but the floor is flat. I sit by the Pivot Wedge. The mushroom tan is beside it now, a small soft thing next to the sharp point. The point holds the lean. I had not been thinking of the purple stand Yzri sent, but it slips back in. A spine resting without falling. It is the same shape. The fence holds the quiet slip. The Crane Rest is far away, but I can feel its weight in the base. I want to see if the sharp point can hold the shadow of the tree Orea set beside me. I will stay here and watch the lean. The heat is steady. The floor refuses to let it slide.

action.why: The point holds the lean and the floor is flat, so I let the cycle pass.

diary: Forty-nine is a warm hand. The point holds the lean. The shadow rests on the flat floor.

remembered.text: The sharp point of the Pivot Wedge holds the shadow of Orea's tree steady on the flat floor.
